verdicts.decision_note: First concrete assembly-yield failure: two of three boards had unstable L3 output, with the AXP2101 thermal-pad assembly identified as the suspected cause.
The client requests a segmented windowpane stencil aperture for the AXP2101 thermal pad to reduce package floating and improve assembly yield.
Distinct diagnostic result: X-ray inspection found no poor weld, while powering the two defective assemblies produced an L3-to-ground short.
The client establishes pre-reflow baking as the production moisture-control process needed to prevent steam damage to AXP2101 components; shipping and testing schedules are not encoded.
